## Solution

**Factorization.** $2015 = 5 \times 13 \times 31$. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, every residue $a \pmod{2015}$ corresponds to a triple $(a_5, a_{13}, a_{31})$, and the image of the power map $x \mapsto x^k \pmod{2015}$ is the Cartesian product of the images modulo each prime.

**Image sizes per prime.** For a prime $p$, the map $x \mapsto x^k$ on $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ has image $\{0\} \cup H_k$, where $H_k$ is the subgroup of $k$-th powers in $(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^*$, of size $\frac{p-1}{\gcd(k,p-1)}$. So the image size is $\frac{p-1}{\gcd(k,p-1)}+1$.

| $p$ | $p-1$ | $k=2$ | $k=3$ | $k=5$ |
|-----|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| 5   | 4     | $4/2+1=3$ | $4/1+1=5$ | $4/1+1=5$ |
| 13  | 12    | $12/2+1=7$ | $12/3+1=5$ | $12/1+1=13$ |
| 31  | 30    | $30/2+1=16$ | $30/3+1=11$ | $30/5+1=7$ |

Let $S_k$ = set of $k$-th power residues mod $2015$:

$$|S_2| = 3\cdot7\cdot16 = 336,\quad |S_3| = 5\cdot5\cdot11 = 275,\quad |S_5| = 5\cdot13\cdot7 = 455.$$

**Intersections.** For each prime, the intersection of $H_{k_1}$ and $H_{k_2}$ is $H_{\operatorname{lcm}(d_{k_1},\,d_{k_2})}$ where $d_k = \gcd(k,p-1)$ (the subgroup of $d$-th powers). Including $0$:

| $p$ | $d_2,d_3,d_5$ | $S_2\cap S_3$ | $S_2\cap S_5$ | $S_3\cap S_5$ | $S_2\cap S_3\cap S_5$ |
|-----|---------------|---------------|---------------|---------------|----------------------|
| 5   | 2,1,1 | $\frac{4}{2}+1=3$ | $\frac{4}{2}+1=3$ | $\frac{4}{1}+1=5$ | $\frac{4}{2}+1=3$ |
| 13  | 2,3,1 | $\frac{12}{6}+1=3$ | $\frac{12}{2}+1=7$ | $\frac{12}{3}+1=5$ | $\frac{12}{6}+1=3$ |
| 31  | 2,3,5 | $\frac{30}{6}+1=6$ | $\frac{30}{10}+1=4$ | $\frac{30}{15}+1=3$ | $\frac{30}{30}+1=2$ |

Taking products via CRT:

$$|S_2\cap S_3| = 3\cdot3\cdot6 = 54,\quad |S_2\cap S_5| = 3\cdot7\cdot4 = 84,$$
$$|S_3\cap S_5| = 5\cdot5\cdot3 = 75,\quad |S_2\cap S_3\cap S_5| = 3\cdot3\cdot2 = 18.$$

**Exactly one protocol.** The number of residues in exactly one of the three sets is:

$$\bigl(|S_2|+|S_3|+|S_5|\bigr) - 2\bigl(|S_2\cap S_3|+|S_2\cap S_5|+|S_3\cap S_5|\bigr) + 3\,|S_2\cap S_3\cap S_5|$$

$$= (336+275+455) - 2(54+84+75) + 3(18) = 1066 - 426 + 54 = \boxed{694}.$$

**Verification of consistency.** Exactly two $= (54+84+75)-3\cdot18 = 213-54 = 159$; exactly three $= 18$. Total in at least one $= 694+159+18 = 871$, which matches the inclusion–exclusion total $1066-213+18 = 871$. ✓

The number of SSA vaults is **694**.

| 13  | 12    | $12/2+1=7$ | $12/3+1=5$ | $12/1+1=13$ |
| 31  | 30    | $30/2+1=16$ | $30/3+1=11$ | $30/5+1=7$ |

$$|S_2| = 3\cdot7\cdot16 = 336,\quad |S_3| = 5\cdot5\cdot11 = 275,\quad |S_5| = 5\cdot13\cdot7 = 455.$$
